name: fast-combo-stremio
description: One Stremio addon that merges all your addons and keeps only working, fast 1080p/4K streams

FC_ACCESS_KEY.description: The **secret part of your addon link**, so strangers can't use it. Type about 12 random letters and numbers (no spaces, just mash the keyboard) and **write it down**.

FC_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: The **password for your control panel**, where you add your addons. Choose one and **write it down**.

FC_KV.description: Storage for **live sync**: changes you make on the control panel reach Stremio without reinstalling. Created for you; just keep it.
